Hi @chas-mafli! I'm [Dosu](https://go.dosu.dev/dosubot) and I'm helping the LlamaIndex team.

I can confirm the bug. The current `get_all` and `aget_all` methods in `RedisKVStore` unconditionally call `key.decode()` on lines 161 and 169, which fails when the Redis client is configured with `decode_responses=True` (since keys are already strings in that case) [[1]](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-integrations/storage/kvstore/llama-index-storage-kvstore-redis/llama_index/storage/kvstore/redis/base.py#L156-L170).

A straightforward fix would be to guard the `.decode()` call with an `isinstance` check:

```python
collection_kv_dict[key.decode() if isinstance(key, bytes) else key] = value
```

This needs to be applied in both `get_all` (line 161) and `aget_all` (line 169) in [`base.py`](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-integrations/storage/kvstore/llama-index-storage-kvstore-redis/llama_index/storage/kvstore/redis/base.py#L156-L170).

As a workaround until this is fixed, you can avoid passing `decode_responses=True` in your `ConnectionPool` configuration — the default (`False`) works correctly with the current implementation.

comments.body:
Hi maintainers — I'd like to take this issue.

Root cause: `get_all` / `aget_all` always call `key.decode()`, which fails when the Redis client uses `decode_responses=True` (keys are already `str`).

Fix: normalize keys with `isinstance(key, bytes)` before decoding, so both client modes work. Includes unit tests for bytes and str key paths (sync + async).

Opening a PR shortly.
